text:
Maya (AE): Hey team, handing over Lightboard trial -> CSM Jorge. Primary context: 50-seat pilot, go-live target 2026-04-15, SSO via Okta, private deploy possible. Renewal window in ~11 months; sales flagged potential renewal risk if cost/SSO slowdowns persist.
Jorge (CSM): Thanks Maya — can you paste the account bundle and SSO metadata here? I'll run an initial health score and scope enablement.
Maya (AE): Pasted notes and docs: https://redwood.internal/notes/lightboard-trial. Main asks: SAML metadata, audit log retention req, dedicated capacity estimate pending. Sample data shared.
Jorge (CSM): Ok. I'll schedule kickoff with Elena and loop Samir for infra review. Owners proposed: Jorge (CSM) - overall enablement/health; Elena (Solutions) - onboarding + training; Samir (Support Eng) - infra/SSO/VPC; Maya (AE) - customer comms.
Elena (Solutions): I'll take training flows + playbook. Need sample prompts + 2 prod-like datasets to build lab exercises. Maya, can you confirm expected prompt volume during pilot?
Maya (AE): Estimated ~1,200 prompts/day during pilot, with spikes on week 2. Also sending datasets now.
Samir (Support Eng): I'll validate VPC & SAML. Can you drop SAML metadata + their private CIDR?
Maya (AE): SAML metadata below and CIDR: 10.4.0.0/16.
```
SAML metadata: <customer-lightboard-metadata.xml>
Private CIDR: 10.4.0.0/16
```
Samir (Support Eng): CIDR overlaps our staging ranges — tagging as a blocker. I'll open an infra ticket (RED-10342) to provision a dedicated VPC for this customer.
Jorge (CSM): Noted. Adding preflight checklist item for VPC CIDR and SSO validation. I'll run preflight next Tue.
Elena (Solutions): For enablement materials I also need API keys (non-prod) and two canonical prompt examples. If we can get one replayable convo dataset that's ideal.
Maya (AE): Sending API key placeholders + prompt examples in the doc now. Also customer budget concern: they're price-sensitive; renewal risk is moderate unless we show optimization wins.
Jorge (CSM): Let's plan monthly usage/cost review with Optimize recommendations. Elena, can you prepare a one-page cost savings note tailored to the pilot usage profile?
Elena (Solutions): Yes — will draft by Friday and include batching/quantization suggestions and expected token reduction.
Samir (Support Eng): Quick technical note: private deploy requires KMS access and audit log retention. If they require HSM-backed keys, procurement lead time is longer — flag for sales/legal.
Maya (AE): Customer also asked about SLA for Dedicated (99.9%). Sales says doable with contract. Keeping that as a commercial note.
Jorge (CSM): Great. Owners + next steps summary:
- Jorge: send kickoff invite, run preflight, produce health score.
- Elena: create enablement playbook + 1p cost note (due Fri).
- Samir: RED-10342 (VPC provisioning) + SSO validation.
- Maya: confirm datasets, SAML metadata, and customer comms cadence.
Samir (Support Eng): Created RED-10342 and assigned. Also left a note on required network egress rules and KMS role trust. :white_check_mark: 
Maya (AE): I'll confirm onboarding window with the customer and update this thread after kickoff.
Elena (Solutions): I'll prep a 60-min training agenda and a short lab with the sample prompts. :eyes: 
Jorge (CSM): I'll capture customer feedback after the first training and feed into evals/regressions. Adding renewal watch label to account.
Maya (AE): Any immediate blockers?
Samir (Support Eng): CIDR overlap + SSO metadata mismatch are current blockers; engineering action open.
Elena (Solutions): Waiting on the datasets (just got notified they'll arrive today).
Jorge (CSM): Cool — kickoff invite sent for Tue 09:30 PT. I'll post a condensed summary here after. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
